implementation: Deployed calibrated Clef plus direct pinned Jev. The first approval permits generation immediately; both checks continue for up to eight seconds with retained completion logging. Supersedes the earlier four-second grace/veto behavior.

rules.approve: First valid approval immediately, even if the other service rejects.
rules.reject: With no approval, reject if at least one valid rejection exists after both complete or the overall deadline expires.
rules.unavailable: No approval or valid rejection when both finish or the deadline expires.
rules.observation: Both services continue to completion or eight seconds from shared start, retained through waitUntil; late replies cannot revise the gate or observation.

calibration.clef: Complete; existing profile retained because the fitted alternative had more false rejects on validation.
calibration.jev: Complete: 305 live direct Jev 1.14.0 score sets; fitted thresholds validated and written to source.
calibration.combined: First-approval union re-evaluated from all 610 recorded provider scores; see first-approval-calibration-report.json.
calibration.observations: Profiles fitted using 217 calibration examples; 40 validation examples selected baseline versus fitted; 48 final-test examples excluded from fitting and selection. Clef observations were reused after explicitly recording the split refinement; TypeSafe used the final fixed split. No claim of blinded or population-level accuracy.

iOSUnitTests.note: XCTest finished all 93 tests with seven skipped and zero failures. Xcode then stalled in simulator diagnostics/result packaging; after interruption the command exited 75. This is not a clean xcodebuild exit.

consent.description: Names direct TypeSafe sharing, requires renewed local permission, and sends X-AI-Sharing-Version:2.
consent.legacy: Older builds including build8 remain Cloudflare-only; updated app required to use direct TypeSafe moderation.

remaining: Upload build 1.0 (9), wait for Apple processing, select it for the rejected app version, and resubmit with the prepared review notes.
paidImageRequestsScope: This deployment/preparation turn: one initial API sheet, three physical-device sheets, one final-policy API sheet.
